adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: Marker 1

url.title: URL
url.description: Root URL of the Marker server (marker_server). It must be reachable from the Unstract containers, so do not use localhost unless Marker runs in the same container.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Format requested from Marker. Markdown is recommended for LLM processing.

force_ocr.title: Force OCR
force_ocr.description: Run OCR on the whole document even if it contains extractable text.

paginate_output.title: Paginate Output
paginate_output.description: Separate pages in the output with page delimiters.

page_range.title: Page Range
page_range.description: Optional pages to process, e.g. 0,5-10,20. Leave empty for all pages.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Marker to process a document.
